polozky.nadpis: Carrying Forward a Lifetime of Service
polozky.perex: Every year, floods, earthquakes, typhoons, and hurricanes cause unfathomable damage to communities all over the world.
polozky.telo: Every year, floods, earthquakes, typhoons, and hurricanes cause unfathomable damage to communities all over the world. When they do, responders know whom to reach out to: GISCorps. A program of the Geospatial Professional Network (GPN), GISCorps has attracted over 12,000 prospective volunteers from 162 countries and launched more than 380 missions worldwide since 2003. But the organization does more than assist with disaster response. It also helps nonprofits develop maps and apps, review and collect datasets, conduct GIS training, and more. polozky.nadpis: Charting the Caribbean’s Future: How Lidar Data Is Transforming Climate Resilience Across the Region
polozky.perex: By Dr. Mark Bynoe and Sven Cowan When a major storm sweeps across the Caribbean, coastlines can change in an instant.
polozky.telo: By Dr. Mark Bynoe and Sven Cowan When a major storm sweeps across the Caribbean, coastlines can change in an instant. Beaches vanish. Cliffs shear away. Floodwaters push inland into neighborhoods and tourist meccas once considered safe. Climate change poses significant problems in the region. Damaging floods and storms have more than tripled since the early 2000s, resulting in countries suffering yearly losses equal to 17% of their GDP. This is seen as perpetual recession as the region grapples with this constant threat. View of Turneffe Atoll, Belize.
